m.t: Normaal gesproken kleed ik me niet zo.

m.e: Why in the world would you need my dress size?

m.e: Land your bird and get in here and back me up.

m.e: I promise we're working around the clock, baron.

m.e: We have been fighting for this for a very long time.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #11538884 by megamanenm; English translation #11538881 by megamanenm
